meta.name: add-macos-statusbar
meta.description: Add a macOS menu bar status indicator for NanoClaw. Shows a bolt icon with a green/red dot indicating whether NanoClaw is running, with Start, Stop, and Restart controls. macOS only.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 在菜单栏显示 NanoClaw 运行状态并控制启停
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在 macOS 菜单栏快速查看和切换 NanoClaw 运行状态
copy.tagline_en: Show NanoClaw status and controls in macOS menu bar
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly check and toggle NanoClaw from the macOS menu bar

howto.what: 在 Mac 菜单栏添加一个闪电图标，显示 NanoClaw 是否在运行：绿点=运行中，红点=已停止。点击图标可开始、停止或重启服务。
howto.when: 当你说“添加 macOS 状态栏指示器”“给 NanoClaw 加菜单栏图标”等类似请求时触发；仅支持 macOS 系统。

say.text: 在我的 Mac 菜单栏上添加 NanoClaw 状态图标
say.note: 会安装菜单栏指示器并显示运行状态。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 增加一个菜单栏运行指示灯
say.note: 菜单栏会出现闪电图标，绿点表示运行中。

say.text: 重新安装 NanoClaw 的菜单栏状态指示器
say.note: 会重新编译并加载状态栏服务。

howto.what_en: Adds a lightning-bolt icon to the Mac menu bar showing NanoClaw's status: green dot when running, red dot when stopped. Click the icon to start, stop, or restart the service.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to add a macOS status-bar indicator or a menu-bar icon for NanoClaw. macOS only.

say_en.text: Add a NanoClaw status icon to my Mac menu bar.
say_en.note: Installs the indicator and shows running status.

say_en.text: Add a menu-bar status light for NanoClaw.
say_en.note: A bolt icon appears, green when running.

say_en.text: Reinstall the NanoClaw menu-bar status indicator.
say_en.note: Recompiles and reloads the status-bar service.
